thread:
alex: Quick midpoint check — can folks post a one-line status for each Q2 milestone (shipped / slipped / owner / blocker). Short is fine, I’ll consolidate.

maya: Runtime v3 (dedicated) — shipped (canary live at 3%); owner maya; blocker: tuning autoscale parameters, low impact. :tada:

sophie: Private deploy templates — slipped; owner sophie; blocker: security review for KMS integration still pending (waiting on review from sec). PR: https://gh/repo/pull/482

rio: Console observability hooks — backend shipped; frontend dashboard WIP; owner rio; blocker: frontend bandwidth (need a reviewer).

sam: I can pick up the frontend dashboard work for 2 days next sprint. I’ll open a CR tonight and tag reviewers.

maya: I’ll review the metrics naming in sam's CR first thing tomorrow. Also, rio, can you add expected query cost to the dashboard ticket so we can decide retention?

alex: Notes on dependencies: sophie's KMS + security review blocks private GA; sam finishing frontend blocks console rollout; maya will handle metrics review. Anything else hiding?

sophie: Legal needs to confirm EU data residency wording before private GA — added notes in the doc (docs/okrs/q2/privacy-eu.md). Legal estimated 48-72h. Escalating now.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: prod-canary at 2023-05-10T16:00Z (auto-rollback 30m). See: https://deploys/reports/3331

alex: Next steps: 1) maya reviews CR (by EOD tomorrow) 2) sophie to escalate KMS + legal and post ETA 3) sam opens CR + adds reviewers 4) rio adds query cost estimate. I’ll update the OKR sheet after you confirm. :white_check_mark:

maya: Ack — will update here when review done.

sam: CR opened: https://gh/repo/pull/490 — tagged @maya @rio. Short description + screenshots in the PR.

sophie: Legal responded — small contract tweak, ETA ~36h. Pushing for same-day.

alex: Thanks all. If anything slips beyond the 36-72h window, call it out here so I can move owners in the OKR tracker and notify GTM.

rio: Putting cost estimate in ticket now.

alex: Closing loop for now. If no objections, I’ll fold this into the weekly OKR update.
